Text:
Moved flats? You have a deadline 🇹🇷

▪️ The rule: Update your address. Foreigners must report a new address within 20 working days of moving.
▪️ Where: Nüfus Müdürlüğü. Bring your ikamet card and your rental contract or a utility bill.
▪️ Why it matters: Ikamet renewals check it. A wrong address can cause problems with your permit.
